## Fatima's impresssions

-   Puzzles were relatively nice

-   A few things around the room looked like potential puzzles, but were not. This created some confusion.

-   There was often a little lag between putting in right solution and seeing it's effect.

-   One of the doors were opened by one puzzle, but we didn't hear it open. Only after the game master told us that some door did open, did we start to look for it.

-   Few puzzles we could have gotten correct, if we were paying a bit more attention.

-   One of the items was used in three different puzzles.

Overall, I think the puzzles were interesting, but the hints to them a bit too confusing. Also, the puzzles weren't really that difficult; time was wasted on confusion.

The organization seemed a little lacking. Even though we arrived well on time, the game started later. The preparatory stage was a bit too messy, with not enough attention from the game masters and unclear procedure. I guess it is not really a place we'd gladly return to.
:::
